fields.quoted_span: Such presumption shall be rebutted only by clear and convincing evidence that such person's action was not a reprisal against the tenant and that such person had sufficient independent justification for taking such action
fields.note: All elements are in the text: protected activities, the six-month presumption, the clear and convincing standard, damages, costs and fees, and void waivers. Minor point: the 'tenant may receive' wording is clumsy, but it is accurate.

fields.quoted_span: shall be liable for damages which shall not be less than one month's rent or more than three month's rent, or the actual damages sustained by the tenant, whichever is greater, and the costs of the suit, including a reasonable attorney's fee.
fields.note: The six-month presumption and the clear and convincing rebuttal standard are both stated in the text. Damages of 1–3 months' rent or actual damages, plus costs and fees, match.

fields.quoted_span: Any waiver of this provision in any lease or other rental agreement shall be void and unenforceable.
fields.note: The document is the statute text as currently presented and shows no repeal or sunset. It does not say outright that the rule is in force.

fields.quoted_span: Any person or agent thereof who threatens to or takes reprisals against any tenant of residential premises
fields.note: The statute covers any residential tenant and states no unit-count, age, or owner-occupancy limits. The nonpayment exception is recorded under exemptions, not coverage.
